Origin and meaning

Maria is a Hebrew name meaning “beloved, or bitter (form of Mary)”.

About the name Maria

The Latin form of Mary, and the name of the opera singer Maria Callas.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Maria as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “beloved, or bitter (form of Mary)”, is part of the appeal.
